india-macro.title: India's exports rise across geographies; Africa, ASEAN lead growth in Apr-Aug
india-macro.summary: India's merchandise exports increased significantly across different regions from April to August this fiscal year. Exports to Africa saw a notable rise of 47 percent, reaching USD 26.19 billion. The ASEAN region also experienced a substantial growth of 56 percent in exports, totaling USD 23.08 billion. Furthermore, shipments to North-East Asia rose by 37 percent, amounting to USD 21.03 billion. Overall, India's total merchandise exports rose by 18.
